record.bible_text: The words<WH01697> of king<WH04428> Lemuel<WH03927>, the prophecy<WH04853> that his mother<WH0517> taught<WH03256><WTH8765> him.

Give<WH05414><WTH8799> not thy strength<WH02428> unto women<WH0802>, nor thy ways<WH01870> to that which destroyeth<WH04229><WTH8687> kings<WH04428>.

<FI> It is<Fi> not for kings<WH04428>, O Lemuel<WH03927>, <FI>it is<Fi> not for kings<WH04428> to drink<WH08354><WTH8800> wine<WH03196>; nor for<WH0335><WTH8675><WH0176> princes<WH07336><WTH8802> strong drink<WH07941>:

Give<WH05414><WTH8798> strong drink<WH07941> unto him that is ready to perish<WH06><WTH8802>, and wine<WH03196> unto those that be of heavy<WH04751> hearts<WH05315>. <RF>of...: Heb. bitter of soul<Rf>
Let him drink<WH08354><WTH8799>, and forget<WH07911><WTH8799> his poverty<WH07389>, and remember<WH02142><WTH8799> his misery<WH05999> no more.
Open<WH06605><WTH8798> thy mouth<WH06310> for the dumb<WH0483> in the cause<WH01779> of all such as are appointed<WH01121> to destruction<WH02475>. <RF>such...: Heb. the sons of destruction<Rf>
Open<WH06605><WTH8798> thy mouth<WH06310>, judge<WH08199><WTH8798> righteously<WH06664>, and plead<WH01777><WTH8798> the cause of the poor<WH06041> and needy<WH034>.<CM>
Who can find<WH04672><WTH8799> a virtuous<WH02428> woman<WH0802>? for her price<WH04377> <FI>is<Fi> far<WH07350> above rubies<WH06443>.
The heart<WH03820> of her husband<WH01167> doth safely trust<WH0982><WTH8804> in her, so that he shall have no need<WH02637><WTH8799> of spoil<WH07998>.
She will do<WH01580><WTH8804> him good<WH02896> and not evil<WH07451> all the days<WH03117> of her life<WH02416>.
She seeketh<WH01875><WTH8804> wool<WH06785>, and flax<WH06593>, and worketh<WH06213><WTH8799> willingly<WH02656> with her hands<WH03709>.
She is like the merchants<WH05503><WTH8802>' ships<WH0591>; she bringeth<WH0935><WTH8686> her food<WH03899> from afar<WH04801>.
She riseth<WH06965><WTH8799> also while it is yet night<WH03915>, and giveth<WH05414><WTH8799> meat<WH02964> to her household<WH01004>, and a portion<WH02706> to her maidens<WH05291>.

She considereth<WH02161><WTH8804> a field<WH07704>, and buyeth<WH03947><WTH8799> it: with the fruit<WH06529> of her hands<WH03709> she planteth<WH05193><WTH8804> a vineyard<WH03754>. <RF>buyeth: Heb. taketh<Rf>
She girdeth<WH02296><WTH8804> her loins<WH04975> with strength<WH05797>, and strengtheneth<WH0553><WTH8762> her arms<WH02220>.
She perceiveth<WH02938><WTH8804> that her merchandise<WH05504> <FI>is<Fi> good<WH02896>: her candle<WH05216> goeth not out<WH03518><WTH8799> by night<WH03915>. <RF>She...: Heb. She tasteth<Rf>
She layeth<WH07971><WTH8765> her hands<WH03027> to the spindle<WH03601>, and her hands<WH03709> hold<WH08551><WTH8804> the distaff<WH06418>.
She stretcheth out<WH06566><WTH8804> her hand<WH03709> to the poor<WH06041>; yea, she reacheth forth<WH07971><WTH8765> her hands<WH03027> to the needy<WH034>. <RF>She...: Heb. She spreadeth<Rf>

She is not afraid<WH03372><WTH8799> of the snow<WH07950> for her household<WH01004>: for all her household<WH01004> <FI>are<Fi> clothed<WH03847><WTH8803> with scarlet<WH08144>. <RF>scarlet: or, double garments<Rf>
She maketh<WH06213><WTH8804> herself coverings of tapestry<WH04765>; her clothing<WH03830> <FI>is<Fi> silk<WH08336> and purple<WH0713>.
Her husband<WH01167> is known<WH03045><WTH8737> in the gates<WH08179>, when he sitteth<WH03427><WTH8800> among the elders<WH02205> of the land<WH0776>.
She maketh<WH06213><WTH8804> fine linen<WH05466>, and selleth<WH04376><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> ; and delivereth<WH05414><WTH8804> girdles<WH02289> unto the merchant<WH03669>.
Strength<WH05797> and honour<WH01926> <FI>are<Fi> her clothing<WH03830>; and she shall rejoice<WH07832><WTH8799> in time<WH03117> to come<WH0314>.
She openeth<WH06605><WTH8804> her mouth<WH06310> with wisdom<WH02451>; and in her tongue<WH03956> <FI>is<Fi> the law<WH08451> of kindness<WH02617>.
She looketh well<WH06822><WTH8802> to the ways<WH01979><WTH8675><WH01979> of her household<WH01004>, and eateth<WH0398><WTH8799> not the bread<WH03899> of idleness<WH06104>.
Her children<WH01121> arise up<WH06965><WTH8804>, and call her blessed<WH0833><WTH8762>; her husband<WH01167> <FI>also<Fi> , and he praiseth<WH01984><WTH8762> her.
Many<WH07227> daughters<WH01323> have done<WH06213><WTH8804> virtuously<WH02428>, but thou excellest<WH05927><WTH8804> them all. <RF>have...: or, have gotten riches<Rf>

Favour<WH02580> <FI>is<Fi> deceitful<WH08267>, and beauty<WH03308> <FI>is<Fi> vain<WH01892>: <FI>but<Fi> a woman<WH0802> <FI>that<Fi> feareth<WH03373> the LORD<WH03068>, she shall be praised<WH01984><WTH8691>.
Give<WH05414><WTH8798> her of the fruit<WH06529> of her hands<WH03027>; and let her own works<WH04639> praise<WH01984><WTH8762> her in the gates<WH08179>.<CM>
